domain: Daemon-side browser perception and request-scoped active-tab observation for a Tauri React Node desktop agent widget, adjacent to browser automation, extension bridges, semantic UI understanding, and safe computer-use control.
summary: Browser Perception is the layer that lets Browser Action deterministically understand the active tab immediately before execution. Iter-19 closes the fresh-observation gap by implementing request-scoped observe_now, explicit extension ack/result/timeout/cancel semantics, PreparedBrowserViewContext storage, SPA stabilization evidence, prompt/direct Browser Action integration, and progress-first UX.

domain_specifics.value: This iteration is not resolver tuning. It is a request-scoped fresh-observation contract between the Manifest V3 Browser Bridge and daemon.

goal.one_liner: Browser Action gets a fresh prepared active-tab context before planning or executing.
goal.primary_value: Connected/allowed browser prompts no longer ask the user to retry while the bridge reads the page.
